keyCollections.whyItMatters: Pilot keeps Zenith's aviation story active in the current catalogue, pairing broad numerals and cockpit-inspired styling with modern automatic and flyback chronograph references.

faqItems.question: What is Zenith Pilot?
faqItems.answer: Pilot is Zenith's aviation-inspired collection, represented today by Pilot Automatic and Pilot Big Date Flyback models.

faqItems.question: Which current Pilot models are useful examples?
faqItems.answer: The official Pilot page shows Pilot Automatic and Pilot Big Date Flyback references in steel and ceramic executions.

timeline.event: Georges Favre-Jacot, aged 22, founds a vertically integrated watch manufacture in Le Locle, Switzerland — one of the first manufactures d'horlogerie.
Wins the Grand Prix at the Paris World's Fair for the 'Zenith' movement; the company later adopts the name.
Officially renamed Fabrique des Montres Zenith S.A. after its celebrated movement.
Introduces the El Primero, the world's first automatic chronograph movement, beating at 36,000 vibrations per hour.
Watchmaker Charles Vermot secretly hides the El Primero tooling in the attic during the quartz crisis, saving the calibre from destruction.
Acquired by LVMH, joining TAG Heuer and Hublot in the group's watch and jewellery division.
Launches the Defy El Primero 21, capable of measuring 1/100th of a second with a dual-escapement system.
Julien Tornare continues as CEO; Zenith pushes the Defy line as the brand's modern pillar alongside the heritage Chronomaster and Pilot collections.
Launches the Defy Skyline, a luxury-sport watch with integrated bracelet and 1/10th-second chronograph, targeting the competitive luxury-sport segment.

Celebrates 160th anniversary with blue ceramic Defy collection and the G.F.J. (Georges Favre-Jacot) tribute watch at Watches & Wonders 2025. Also releases Chronomaster Sport Rainbow, Defy Skyline Chronograph Skeleton, Defy Zero G Blue Sapphire, and Defy Extreme Lapis Lazuli limited edition.
Wins the Chronometry Prize at the 25th Grand Prix d'Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG) for the revived Calibre 135 G.F.J.
Debuts the Defy Skyline Skeleton in black ceramic and rose gold at LVMH Watch Week. Announced as the movement developer and producer for multiple LVMH brands including Tiffany & Co. and Gérald Genta.

faqItems.question: What is the El Primero?
faqItems.answer: Launched in 1969, the El Primero is the world's first integrated automatic chronograph movement, famous for its 36,000 vph frequency enabling 1/10th-second precision.

faqItems.question: Who owns Zenith?
faqItems.answer: Zenith has been a subsidiary of LVMH since 1999. It remains headquartered in its original manufacture in Le Locle, Switzerland.

faqItems.question: How was the El Primero saved during the quartz crisis?
faqItems.answer: Watchmaker Charles Vermot secretly hid the El Primero tooling and parts in the attic of the Le Locle factory, preserving the calibre when management ordered mechanical production stopped.

name: Zeppelin
description: The family-owned company POINTtec from Munich-Ismaning produces the Zeppelin brand — aviation-inspired watches named after the legendary airships of Count Ferdinand von Zeppelin. Each collection celebrates a milestone in German aviation history with reliable movements, retro-modern dials and that distinctly German combination of romance and precision.

keyCollections.name: LZ 127 Graf Zeppelin
keyCollections.description: Collection inspired by the famous Graf Zeppelin airship, featuring aviator-style dials with classic Bauhaus-influenced design.

keyCollections.name: LZ 129 Hindenburg
keyCollections.description: Elegant collection paying tribute to the Hindenburg airship, with moonphase and power-reserve complications in Art Deco cases.

keyCollections.name: 100 Years Zeppelin
keyCollections.description: Anniversary collection celebrating a century of Zeppelin aviation history with automatic movements and retro-inspired dial layouts.

timeline.event: Lothar Schmidt founds PointTec Electronic GmbH in Ismaning, near Munich, Germany.
Launches the Zeppelin watch brand, inspired by the golden age of German airship travel.
The LZ 127 Graf Zeppelin collection becomes the brand's signature, earning a following for its aviator aesthetic and German engineering.
Introduces the LZ 129 Hindenburg collection with moonphase and power-reserve complications at accessible price points.
Expands the product range with new Captain's Line and Atlantic models; brand remains popular in Germany and Japan for its retro aviation aesthetic.
POINTtec continues producing Zeppelin alongside sister brand Iron Annie, maintaining the aviation-inspired vintage aesthetic at accessible price points with Miyota and Sellita movements.

faqItems.question: Are Zeppelin watches German-made?
faqItems.answer: Zeppelin is a German brand based near Munich. Many models use German-assembled cases with reliable Japanese or Swiss movements, positioned as affordable heritage watches.

faqItems.question: What is the connection to airships?
faqItems.answer: The brand is officially licensed to use the Zeppelin name and imagery, celebrating the golden age of German airship travel in its design language and collection names.

name: Zodiac
description: Zodiac was founded in Le Locle in 1882 and was known during the 20th century for its Sea Wolf dive watch — one of the first commercially available dive watches — and distinctive cushion-shaped Aerospace GMT. Owned by Fossil Group since 2001, the brand continues to produce re-editions of its vintage classics.

keyCollections.name: Sea Wolf
keyCollections.description: Zodiac's legendary dive watch, first introduced in 1953 as one of the first purpose-built commercial dive watches, predating the Rolex Submariner.

keyCollections.name: Super Sea Wolf
keyCollections.description: Evolution of the Sea Wolf from the early 1970s, rated to 750 metres and used by US Navy SEALs, now the brand's core modern collection.

keyCollections.name: Aerospace
keyCollections.description: GMT watch introduced in 1960 inspired by the Sea Wolf design, featuring a dual-colour bezel and red GMT hand for travellers.

timeline.event: Ariste Calame founds a watch workshop in Le Locle, Switzerland, originally under his own name.
The name 'Zodiac' is officially registered as the brand name.
Introduces the Autographic, a self-winding watch with a power-reserve indicator, unbreakable crystal, and water resistance.
Launches the Sea Wolf, one of the first commercially produced dive watches, ahead of the Rolex Submariner.
Releases the Aerospace GMT, expanding beyond dive watches into travel-oriented timepieces.
Introduces the Super Sea Wolf rated to 750 metres with a patented crown system, adopted by US Navy SEALs.
Acquired by Fossil Group, which revives heritage models while maintaining Swiss manufacturing in Bienne.
Under Fossil Group, Zodiac relaunches heritage models including the Super Sea Wolf, tapping into the vintage dive watch revival.
Launches the Sea-Chron diver's chronograph, combining the brand's dive heritage with chronograph functionality.

Parent company Fossil Group files Chapter 15 bankruptcy in October 2025. Zodiac identified as a core brand to be preserved. Massive clearance sales see watches at up to 85% off retail. Restructuring finalised November 2025.
Releases the Zodiac x GiantMouse Pro-Diver Automatic watch and dive knife set, a cross-category collaboration blending horology with EDC culture.

faqItems.question: Is Zodiac a Swiss brand?
faqItems.answer: Founded in 1882 in Le Locle, Switzerland, Zodiac is now owned by Fossil Group (USA) but manufacturing remains in Bienne, Switzerland, maintaining its Swiss Made heritage.

faqItems.question: What is the Zodiac Sea Wolf?
faqItems.answer: Launched in 1953, the Sea Wolf was one of the first commercially produced dive watches. It predated the Rolex Submariner and remains Zodiac's most iconic model.

faqItems.question: Who owns Zodiac today?
faqItems.answer: Fossil Group acquired Zodiac in 2001. The brand continues to produce Swiss-made watches focused on its dive-watch heritage, particularly the Super Sea Wolf line.

name: L'Epée 1839
description: Swiss luxury clock manufacturer, known for creative and artistic mechanical clocks. Part of the Swiza Group.

keyCollections.name: Carriage Clocks
keyCollections.description: L’Epée 1839’s Carriage Clocks are a traditional-meets-modern continuation of the 19th-century officer’s carriage clock, combining classic transportable clock architecture, in-house Swiss manufacture, and decorative variants such as Anglaise and Ovale with up to eight-day power reserves and refined glass-cased presentations.
keyCollections.whyItMatters: This line anchors the brand’s heritage identity: it keeps the carriage-clock format alive while showcasing L’Epée 1839’s in-house mechanical expertise and reinterpretation of a historic desk-and-travel clock form.

referenceDetails.name: Anglaise
referenceDetails.note: Classic carriage-clock family entry on the official Carriage Clock page and detailed on its Anglaise product page.

referenceDetails.name: Corniche
referenceDetails.note: Historic carriage-clock variant listed on the official Carriage Clock page and detailed on its product page.

referenceDetails.name: Ovale
referenceDetails.note: Modern oval carriage-clock family entry shown on the official Carriage Clock page and detailed on its Ovale product page.

timeline.event: L’Epée 1839 continues presenting Carriage Clock variants on its official creation pages, including Anglaise, Corniche, and Ovale.
The official site frames the category as a living continuation of the brand’s high-end clockmaking heritage and in-house production.
The collection remains positioned as a traditional carriage-clock family within the broader table-clock offering, distinct from contemporary and creative-art lines.

faqItems.question: What defines L’Epée 1839 Carriage Clocks?
faqItems.answer: They are the brand’s heritage-oriented clock family, centered on the classic carriage-clock format and offered in variants such as Anglaise, Corniche, and Ovale.

faqItems.question: Where is the official collection page?
faqItems.answer: The official collection page is the Carriage Clock page on L’Epée 1839’s website.

keyCollections.name: Table Clocks
keyCollections.description: L’Epée 1839’s Table Clocks are the brand’s broader mechanical-clock category, spanning classic carriage clocks, contemporary design clocks, and avant-garde kinetic objects that are built and finished as display-worthy horological sculptures rather than ordinary desktop clocks.
keyCollections.whyItMatters: This is the umbrella category that explains the brand’s identity: a Swiss manufacture dedicated to high-end clocks, where form, function, complications, and artistic presentation are treated as a single object language.

referenceDetails.name: Creative Art Residency
referenceDetails.note: Official brand line describing unique creations and artistic partnerships within the creative-art side of the clock catalog.

image.alt: L’Epée 1839 Creative Art Residency clock artwork

referenceDetails.name: The Gekko
referenceDetails.note: Official sculptural timepiece that can be mounted on a wall or placed on a table, illustrating the brand’s table-clock and kinetic-object approach.

referenceDetails.name: ORB
referenceDetails.note: Official MB&F collaboration presented as part of the creative art line and described as a clean-designed sphere with an hour-striking mechanism.

timeline.event: The official homepage states that L’Epée 1839 offers an exceptional table-clock collection spanning classic carriage clocks, contemporary design clocks, and avant-garde pieces.
Creative Art Residency formalizes the brand’s art-led collaborations as unique kinetic sculptures.
The Gekko extends the table-clock idea by working both as a wall-mounted object and as a tabletop clock.

faqItems.question: What does Table Clocks include at L’Epée 1839?
faqItems.answer: It is the umbrella category for the brand’s high-end mechanical clocks, including classic, contemporary, and art-led creations.

faqItems.question: Is the collection focused on horology or sculpture?
faqItems.answer: Both. The official brand language repeatedly frames these objects as kinetic pieces of art with fully mechanical clockmaking inside.

keyCollections.name: Contemporary Timepieces
keyCollections.description: L'Epée 1839 Contemporary Timepieces are sculptural mechanical creations that emphasize visible movement, architectural lines, and complication displays.
keyCollections.whyItMatters: Contemporary Timepieces are L'Epée 1839's modern-facing platform for inventive table clocks, where movement, complications, and object design are intentionally visible.

referenceDetails.name: Le Duel
referenceDetails.note: Official contemporary product page emphasizing the visible 40-day movement and sword-inspired architecture.

referenceDetails.name: Le Duel Perpetuel
referenceDetails.note: Official page for the perpetual-calendar continuation of the Le Duel contemporary timepiece.

referenceDetails.name: Le Duel Perpetuel Tourbillon
referenceDetails.note: Official tourbillon-equipped continuation of the Le Duel concept.

image.alt: L'Epée 1839 Le Duel Perpetuel Tourbillon clock

timeline.event: L’Epée 1839’s official contemporary pages present Le Duel as a modern and emblematic collection with a visible 40-day movement.
The brand extends the concept with Le Duel Perpetuel, adding an in-line perpetual calendar and retrograde seconds.
The line continues into Le Duel Perpetuel Tourbillon, combining tourbillon, perpetual calendar, and double retrograde seconds.

faqItems.question: What makes Contemporary Timepieces different from Carriage Clocks?
faqItems.answer: They are more experimental and sculptural, emphasizing visible mechanisms, animation, and contemporary architecture.

faqItems.question: Which Le Duel models represent the line?
faqItems.answer: Official examples include Le Duel, Le Duel Perpetuel, and Le Duel Perpetuel Tourbillon.

timeline.event: Auguste L'Epée founds a manufacture in Sainte-Suzanne, France, specialising in music boxes and clock components.
Becomes a major supplier of carriage and platform clock movements, winning medals at international exhibitions.
Establishes a headquarters in Switzerland, focusing exclusively on high-end carriage clocks.
L'Epée is acquired by Swiza and moves operations to Delémont in the Swiss Jura.
Relaunches under the L'Epée 1839 name with a new creative direction focused on contemporary artistic clocks.
First collaborations with independent watchmakers and designers produce limited-edition table clocks that redefine the category.

faqItems.question: What is L'Epée 1839 known for?
faqItems.answer: L'Epée 1839 is Switzerland's leading specialist in high-end mechanical clocks, particularly carriage and artistic table clocks with long power reserves and sculptural designs.

faqItems.question: Where is L'Epée 1839 based?
faqItems.answer: The manufacture is based in Delémont, in the Swiss Jura, where it designs and assembles all of its clocks in-house.

faqItems.question: Does L'Epée 1839 make wristwatches?
faqItems.answer: No. L'Epée 1839 focuses exclusively on clocks, although it regularly collaborates with independent watchmakers on shared creative projects.

name: Nacar
description: Founded in 1921 by Turkish-Armenian brothers Ohannes and Kevork Nacaroglu, Nacar is one of Turkey's most storied watch brands. With Swiss roots in Bienne and a commercial legacy stretching across nearly a century in Istanbul, the brand gained renewed global attention when Olympic silver medallist Yusuf Dikec wore a $40 Nacar at the 2024 Paris Games.

hq.address: Ercument Batanay Sk. Dumankaya Ikon Plaza A2 Blok No: 45, Atasehir

keyCollections.name: Classic
keyCollections.description: Heritage-inspired dress watches that pay tribute to Nacar's century-long legacy, featuring clean dials and timeless proportions.

keyCollections.name: Sport
keyCollections.description: Durable everyday timepieces combining Turkish identity with modern quartz reliability, built for active wear at accessible price points.

timeline.event: Brothers Ohannes and Kevork Nacaroglu establish the Zila Watch company in Bienne, Switzerland, creating the Nacar brand.
Kevork begins selling Swiss-made Nacar watches in Turkey, quickly establishing the brand as a household name.
Nacar sold to Konyali Saatcilik, which continues production and distribution across Turkey.
Turkish Olympic shooter Yusuf Dikec wears a Nacar at the Paris Olympics, sparking worldwide interest in the brand.

faqItems.question: Where are Nacar watches made?
faqItems.answer: Nacar's quartz models are manufactured in the Far East, while mechanical watches are produced in Switzerland. The brand is headquartered in Istanbul.

faqItems.question: What is the significance of the Nacar name?
faqItems.answer: Nacar derives from the surname of founders Ohannes and Kevork Nacaroglu, Turkish-Armenian brothers who pioneered watchmaking between Bienne and Istanbul.

name: B360
description: Headquartered in the heart of Dubai, B360 has carved a singular niche in contemporary horology with hand-painted artistic dials, each marked 1-of-1. Since its 2010 debut, the brand has collaborated with miniature artists worldwide to produce over 20,000 unique pieces celebrating Arabic heritage, national pride and equestrian culture.

keyCollections.name: B Proud
keyCollections.description: B360 B Proud is the brand's color-forward identity collection, mixing national-pride editions, Arabic numerals, Swiss quartz movements, and hand-painted limited pieces in compact 40 mm cases.

referenceDetails.name: B Proud Turquoise
referenceDetails.note: A current B Proud color-gradient model with Arabic numerals, a turquoise shadow dial, sapphire crystal, and 5 ATM water resistance.

referenceDetails.name: Qatar World Champions Limited Edition
referenceDetails.note: A 100-piece Qatar Champions edition that B360 describes as part of the B Proud collection and as an expression of national identity.

image.alt: B360 Qatar World Champions Limited Edition watch

referenceDetails.name: The Enigmatic Grin
referenceDetails.note: A one-of-one B Proud hand-painted piece with a shadow green and black dial, positioned by B360 as a creative break from convention.

image.alt: B360 B Proud SR.3010 The Enigmatic Grin watch

keyCollections.whyItMatters: B Proud is the easiest entry point into B360's visual language: patriotic color, Arabic-numeral layouts, hand-painted one-off dials, and Swiss quartz specifications in approachable limited editions.

keyCollections.name: The Leaders
keyCollections.description: B360 The Leaders gathers the brand's hand-painted portrait watches, using Swiss quartz movements and signed miniature-painted dials to celebrate political and cultural figures from the Gulf region.

referenceDetails.name: Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
referenceDetails.note: A one-of-one hand-painted portrait watch listed in B360's The Leaders collection, with a decorated case and artist-signed dial certificate.

image.alt: B360 The Leaders REF 24430 hand-painted portrait watch

referenceDetails.name: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashed Al Maktoum
referenceDetails.note: A one-of-one The Leaders model with a green sun-ray portrait dial, sapphire crystal, leather strap, and additional rubber strap.

image.alt: B360 The Leaders SR.5260 hand-painted portrait watch

referenceDetails.name: The Leaders Qatar
referenceDetails.note: A Qatar-focused The Leaders watch with an embossed portrait dial, silicon strap, sapphire crystal, and 5 ATM water resistance.

keyCollections.whyItMatters: The Leaders shows B360 at its most literal as a miniature-painting watchmaker, turning portraiture, regional symbolism, and one-of-one presentation into the core identity of the watch.

image.alt: B360 The Leaders REF 24430 hand-painted portrait watch

keyCollections.name: Arabian Horses
keyCollections.description: B360 Arabian Horses is the brand's equestrian-art family, built around hand-painted horse portraits, Arabic heritage storytelling, Swiss quartz movements, and compact stainless-steel cases.

referenceDetails.name: B360 The Arabian Hand-Painted Horse
referenceDetails.note: B360 describes Arabian Horses as an exclusive collection rooted in Arab cultural history, with hand-painted dials and artist-signed certificates.

image.alt: B360 Arabian Horses hand-painted horse watch

referenceDetails.name: The Arabian Horse Gold Championship Shanghai EA 2022
referenceDetails.note: B360's official product text says the Arabian collection included more than 70 hand-painted watches, with this model dedicated to the stallion Shanghai E.A.

image.alt: B360 Arabian Horse Gold Championship Shanghai EA 2022 watch

referenceDetails.name: B360 The Arabian Hand-Painted Horse 19
referenceDetails.note: A second official Arabian Hand-Painted Horse product record, useful for showing the family as a series of individual hand-painted equestrian dials rather than a single model.

image.alt: B360 Arabian Horses hand-painted horse watch 19

keyCollections.whyItMatters: Arabian Horses gives B360 a clear cultural-art lane, translating equestrian heritage into individually painted dials rather than treating the horse motif as simple decoration.

image.alt: B360 Arabian Horses hand-painted horse watch

gallery.alt: B360 Arabian Horse Gold Championship Shanghai EA 2022 watch
B360 Arabian Horses hand-painted horse watch 19

faqItems.question: What is B360 Arabian Horses?
faqItems.answer: Arabian Horses is B360's hand-painted equestrian art-watch family, built around horse portraits and Arab cultural storytelling.

faqItems.question: Are Arabian Horses models identical?
faqItems.answer: No. B360 presents the family as individual hand-painted pieces, with product records showing distinct horse portraits and limited one-of-one style positioning.

funFacts.title: Artist certificates
funFacts.body: B360's official product text says each hand-painted dial is accompanied by a certificate signed by the B360 artist.

funFacts.title: Large hand-painted run
funFacts.body: B360 says the Arabian collection consisted of more than 70 hand-painted watches, each dedicated to a specific horse.

timeline.event: B360 launches from the labs of Oryx Jewellery in Dubai with its first UAE National Day commemorative watch.
Collaboration with award-winning miniature artists begins, establishing the hand-painted 1-of-1 dial as the brand's signature.
Flagship boutique opens at Dubai Mall and Atlantis The Palm; brand reaches 20 retail locations worldwide.
B360 expands into European partnerships, reaching collectors beyond the Middle East.

faqItems.question: Are B360 dials really hand-painted?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Every B360 watch features a miniature painting executed by hand on the dial, making each piece a unique 1-of-1 artwork. The brand has produced over 20,000 individual art pieces.

faqItems.question: Where is B360 based?
faqItems.answer: B360 is headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with boutique presence at Wafi Mall and Atlantis The Palm, as well as retail partners across the Middle East and Europe.

name: Vyntage Horology
description: The personal horological venture of Mohammed Abdulmagied Seddiqi, scion of the Ahmed Seddiqi & Sons dynasty, Vyntage Horology channels seven decades of family expertise into an independent Emirati brand. Launched at Dubai Watch Week 2023, the house creates Swiss-made timepieces in aluminum, tantalum and precious metals with a focus on sustainability and boundary-pushing materials.

hq.address: Ahmed Seddiqi & Sons, Dubai Mall, Financial Centre Road

keyCollections.name: Purity
keyCollections.description: A time-only collection in lightweight aluminum and exotic metals including tantalum and onyx, celebrating material innovation with minimalist dial design.

keyCollections.name: Monograph
keyCollections.description: Chronograph-inspired pieces featuring layered sub-dials and textured surfaces, blending classical Swiss watchmaking with contemporary Emirati identity.

keyCollections.name: Strata
keyCollections.description: An integrated-bracelet luxury sport watch powered by a Vaucher micro-rotor movement, marking the brand's entry into the competitive steel sports segment.

timeline.event: Mohammed Abdulmagied Seddiqi begins conceptualising a personal watch brand rooted in the family's seven-decade horological legacy.
First collaboration piece launches under the Vyntage name as a one-time limited edition.
Vyntage Horology formally debuts at Dubai Watch Week with the Purity and Monograph collections.
Purity Tantonyx edition in tantalum and onyx unveiled; Purity x Seddiqi 75th Anniversary limited to 25 pieces.
Launch of the Strata integrated-bracelet sports watch with Vaucher micro-rotor movement.

faqItems.question: Who is behind Vyntage Horology?
faqItems.answer: Mohammed Abdulmagied Seddiqi, CEO of Ahmed Seddiqi & Sons, the Middle East's preeminent luxury watch retailer with a 75-year legacy in horology.

faqItems.question: Where are Vyntage watches made?
faqItems.answer: Vyntage Horology watches are Swiss-made, with movements sourced from established Swiss calibre manufacturers. The brand emphasises sustainability in its material choices.

faqItems.question: Where can I buy a Vyntage watch?
faqItems.answer: Vyntage Horology is available at Ahmed Seddiqi & Sons boutiques in Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates, as well as through the brand's website.

name: Maghnam
description: An audacious independent from Qatar, Maghnam is the creation of engineer-turned-watchmaker Sohaib Maghnam, who treats each timepiece as sculptural body armour rather than a conventional instrument. Rooted in Arab heritage and executed with Swiss precision, the brand's transformative cases and retrograde movements have earned recognition from Fratello, Monochrome and Revolution.

keyCollections.name: Mohareb
keyCollections.description: Arabic for 'gladiator', this flagship collection features a transformative case and bi-retrograde movement, conceived as wrist armour inspired by Arab warrior heritage.

keyCollections.name: Makina
keyCollections.description: The brand's inaugural creation, a wearable machine exploring modularity and sculptural construction through bold industrial aesthetics.

keyCollections.name: Noor
keyCollections.description: Meaning 'light' in Arabic, a futuristic collection that plays with luminosity, transparency and unconventional time display.

timeline.event: Sohaib Maghnam leaves his automotive engineering career to pursue independent watchmaking full-time.
Launch of the Makina, Maghnam's first watch, hinting at the brand's sculptural and modular design language.
Debut of the Mohareb with bi-retrograde display and transformative case, earning widespread critical acclaim.
Revolution x Maghnam Mohareb Ocean Relic and Desert Relic collaboration editions released.

faqItems.question: What does Maghnam mean?
faqItems.answer: Maghnam is the surname of founder Sohaib Maghnam, a Qatari engineer-designer who brings an automotive engineering sensibility to independent watchmaking.

faqItems.question: What makes Maghnam watches unique?
faqItems.answer: Every Maghnam watch carries an Arabic name and is designed as a three-dimensional sculptural object rather than a flat-dial instrument. The Mohareb features a transformative case inspired by warrior armour with a bi-retrograde movement.

name: Chronora
description: A young Emirati brand born in Abu Dhabi, Chronora is the passion project of founder Awadh Al Mur, who spent over three years refining a debut chronograph that fuses vintage charm with modern craftsmanship. Inspired by the natural beauty of the UAE, the brand's carefully proportioned 38.5 mm bi-compax chronographs have drawn attention at Dubai Watch Week.

keyCollections.name: Chronograph
keyCollections.description: The inaugural collection of bi-compax chronographs in 38.5 mm stainless steel, available in gradient grey, gradient blue-grey and matte brown, with 24-hour and 60-minute counters.

timeline.event: Awadh Al Mur begins a three-year design process to create a chronograph that balances vintage proportions with modern materials.
Chronora officially launches with three bi-compax chronograph references inspired by the natural beauty of the UAE.
Chronora participates in Dubai Watch Week, gaining international recognition among independent watch enthusiasts.

faqItems.question: What does Chronora mean?
faqItems.answer: Chronora derives from the Greek word 'chronos' (time), symbolising a deep connection to tradition while the brand's contemporary aesthetic embodies the future of watchmaking.

faqItems.question: Where is Chronora based?
faqItems.answer: Chronora is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The brand was founded by Awadh Al Mur to capture the timeless Emirati spirit through modern Swiss-made chronographs.

name: Adi Watches
description: Israel's largest watch manufacturer, Adi has been producing timepieces at its Kvutzat Yavneh kibbutz factory since 1984. Field-proven on the wrists of IDF pilots, officers and special-forces operators, the brand bridges tactical military heritage with Judaica-inspired design, offering over 200 models from diving instruments to Hebrew-alphabet dress watches.

keyCollections.name: IDF Tactical
keyCollections.description: Purpose-built military watches worn by Israeli Defence Forces units, featuring unit insignias, tritium lume and rugged stainless-steel or titanium cases.

keyCollections.name: Judaica
keyCollections.description: Hebrew-alphabet and Judaica-themed dress watches celebrating 3,000 years of cultural heritage, with classic typography and Star of David motifs.

keyCollections.name: Diving
keyCollections.description: Professional-grade dive watches rated to 200 metres, designed and assembled in Israel for both military and civilian use.

timeline.event: Watch factory established at Kvutzat Yavneh kibbutz, beginning production of military timepieces for the Israeli Defence Forces.
Adi expands from military supply into consumer collections, introducing Judaica and Hebrew-alphabet designs.
Product range surpasses 200 models spanning tactical, diving, sport and dress categories.
Release of the '70 Years of Israel' commemorative edition celebrating the nation's anniversary.

faqItems.question: Are Adi watches used by the IDF?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Adi is the official watch supplier to multiple IDF units, including the Air Force and Navy. Soldiers often receive an Adi watch bearing their unit's insignia during training.

faqItems.question: Where are Adi watches made?
faqItems.answer: All Adi watches are designed and manufactured in Israel at the kibbutz factory in Kvutzat Yavneh, using Citizen movements and high-quality materials including stainless steel and titanium.

name: HMT
description: Hindustan Machine Tools was India's pioneering watchmaker, established in 1961 in collaboration with Citizen Watch of Japan. At its zenith during the 1970s and 1980s, HMT was the largest supplier of wristwatches in India, producing iconic mechanical models like the Janata and Pilot that became cultural touchstones for an entire generation.

hq.address: HMT Bhavan, No. 59, Bellary Road, Jalahalli

keyCollections.name: Janata
keyCollections.description: The people's watch — a hand-wound mechanical timepiece that became synonymous with Indian horology, beloved for its simplicity, durability, and democratic price point.

keyCollections.name: Pilot
keyCollections.description: An aviation-inspired mechanical watch with a bold dial and luminous indices, widely regarded as HMT's most collectible model and a favourite among vintage enthusiasts worldwide.

keyCollections.name: Sona
keyCollections.description: A refined dress watch in HMT's lineup, featuring a gilt dial and slim profile that represented the brand's aspirational tier.

timeline.event: HMT Watch Division established in Bangalore in collaboration with Citizen Watch of Japan. The first batch of mechanical wristwatches is released by Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.
HMT becomes India's largest watch manufacturer, operating five factories across Bangalore, Tumkur, Srinagar, and Ranibagh.
Peak production era with HMT holding dominant market share in India before the entry of Titan and quartz competition.
Sustained losses begin as the brand fails to adapt to the quartz revolution and increasing competition from Titan and imported watches.
The watch division officially closes after years of mounting losses, ending over five decades of Indian mechanical watchmaking heritage.

faqItems.question: Why did HMT close?
faqItems.answer: HMT's watch division suffered over a decade of heavy financial losses, unable to compete with modern quartz watchmakers like Titan. The Government of India approved the closure of the watch division in 2016.

faqItems.question: Are HMT watches collectible?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Vintage HMT models — particularly the Pilot, Janata, and Sona — have a passionate global collector base. They are prized for their robust hand-wound movements, historical significance, and accessible entry into mechanical watchmaking.

faqItems.question: Did HMT make its own movements?
faqItems.answer: HMT initially produced movements based on Citizen designs under licence, eventually developing in-house calibres for its mechanical watches at its Bangalore factory.

graveyard.defunctReason: Sustained financial losses and inability to compete with quartz watchmakers
graveyard.reason: The watch division was closed by the Government of India after over a decade of losses
graveyard.epitaph: India's timekeeper to the nation — the watch that ticked on the wrists of a billion dreams.

name: Jaipur Watch Company
description: India's first luxury watch microbrand, Jaipur Watch Company fuses traditional Rajasthani craftsmanship with contemporary horology. Founded by Gaurav Mehta, the brand is celebrated for its bespoke timepieces incorporating uncirculated coins, miniature paintings, and hand-engraved dials that preserve centuries of Indian cultural heritage on the wrist.

keyCollections.name: Coin Collection
keyCollections.description: Signature bespoke watches featuring uncirculated coins from India's colonial and post-independence eras set into the dial, each piece a wearable artefact of monetary history.

keyCollections.name: Hand Painted
keyCollections.description: Limited-edition watches with dials adorned by traditional Indian miniature paintings, executed by master artisans using techniques passed down through generations.

keyCollections.name: Filigree Wristwear
keyCollections.description: A collection inspired by the ancient Rajasthani art of filigree metalwork, incorporating ornate lattice patterns and heritage coins into elegant wristwear.

timeline.event: Gaurav Mehta founds Jaipur Watch Company, selling his BMW and borrowing from friends to create India's first luxury watch microbrand.
Appears on Shark Tank India, gaining nationwide visibility and dramatically increasing consumer interest in the brand.
Secures funding through two successful investment rounds and expands to five exclusive stores across India.
Raises 6.5 crore INR in angel funding at a 45 crore valuation, signals international expansion with a Dubai retail partnership.

faqItems.question: What makes Jaipur Watch Company unique?
faqItems.answer: Each watch incorporates authentic Indian heritage elements — uncirculated coins, miniature paintings, or traditional filigree work — making every piece a wearable artefact of Indian cultural history.

faqItems.question: What is the price range?
faqItems.answer: Timepieces are priced between approximately 22,000 and 45,000 INR, positioning the brand as an accessible luxury microbrand with bespoke craftsmanship.

faqItems.question: Does Jaipur Watch Company use Indian movements?
faqItems.answer: The brand uses reliable Japanese automatic and quartz movements, focusing its differentiation on dial artistry, heritage materials, and handcrafted finishing.

name: Delhi Watch Company
description: Delhi Watch Company channels the spirit of India's capital into every dial — from the labyrinthine lanes of Chandni Chowk to the Mughal grandeur of Mehrauli. Co-founded by Mohit Jain and Sagar Gahlot, this heritage-inspired microbrand produces affordable, design-forward timepieces that celebrate Delhi's architectural and cultural tapestry.

hq.address: Unit No. 23, 1st Floor, Numbardar Building, Grace Road

keyCollections.name: Dilli 36
keyCollections.description: A collection of 36 watches, each dedicated to an iconic Delhi neighbourhood, with dials featuring Mughal-era patterns and architectural motifs drawn from the city's heritage.

keyCollections.name: Chandni Chowk Bazaar
keyCollections.description: Quartz watches with dials inspired by the colours and jali lattice patterns of Old Delhi's legendary spice market — a sensory celebration of the capital's oldest commercial quarter.

keyCollections.name: Janpath Automatics
keyCollections.description: Named after Delhi's iconic flea market, this automatic collection pairs Japanese movements with retro-inspired case designs and heritage-rich dial art.

timeline.event: Mohit Jain and Sagar Gahlot found Delhi Watch Company as a series of design experiments exploring Indian heritage through affordable watch design.
Launches the Dilli 36 collection, establishing the brand's identity as a city-focused storytelling microbrand.
Expands the range to include automatic movements and gains traction among India's growing watch enthusiast community.

faqItems.question: What is the Dilli 36 collection?
faqItems.answer: A collection of 36 watches, each representing one of Delhi's iconic neighbourhoods — from Connaught Place to Chandni Chowk — with dials featuring architectural motifs and cultural symbols unique to each area.

faqItems.question: Where are Delhi Watch Company watches made?
faqItems.answer: The watches are designed in India with Japanese quartz and automatic movements, focusing on heritage-inspired dial art and accessible pricing.

name: Franklord
description: Born from a family manufacturing legacy spanning over three decades, Franklord represents the next chapter in Indian watchmaking. Co-founded by Sufiyan Mulla and Jay Khatri, the brand draws on 35 years of contract manufacturing expertise to produce premium timepieces that are designed, manufactured, and assembled entirely in India.

hq.address: 216, 1st Floor, A Wing, Silver Business Point, Anjurphata Road, Mankoli Naka, Bhiwandi

keyCollections.name: Heritage Open Heart
keyCollections.description: An open-heart collection that exposes the beating movement through the dial, merging classical watchmaking aesthetics with the brand's Indian manufacturing heritage.

keyCollections.name: Maha Vastu
keyCollections.description: Roman-inspired watches blending ancient Indian Vastu principles with classical European design motifs — a culturally distinctive fusion collection.

keyCollections.name: Regal Sapphire
keyCollections.description: A refined collection featuring sapphire crystal, open-heart dials, and polished finishing, positioned as the brand's corporate gifting and dress-watch line.

timeline.event: The Mulla family establishes a watch manufacturing facility in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, beginning decades of contract manufacturing for Indian and international brands.
Sufiyan Mulla and Jay Khatri launch Franklord as a direct-to-consumer brand, leveraging 35 years of family manufacturing expertise.
Expands its collection portfolio with the Heritage Open Heart and Maha Vastu lines, gaining recognition as a credible made-in-India luxury microbrand.

faqItems.question: Are Franklord watches made in India?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Franklord watches are designed, manufactured, and assembled in India at the brand's facility in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, building on over 35 years of family watchmaking heritage.

faqItems.question: What movements does Franklord use?
faqItems.answer: Franklord uses Japanese automatic and quartz movements, with the brand's differentiation focused on in-house manufacturing capability, dial finishing, and Indian design heritage.

name: Horpa
description: Horpa — an acronym for Horology and Passion — is a Mumbai-based independent watch brand founded by luxury watch industry veteran Rajeev Asrani and Deepak Choudhury. The brand fuses traditional horological sensibility with bold, colour-forward design, crafting contemporary timepieces that signal a new era of Indian watchmaking confidence.

keyCollections.name: Men's Collection
keyCollections.description: Bold, colour-rich watches for men powered by Japanese quartz movements, featuring experimental dial designs that push the boundaries of Indian watch aesthetics.

keyCollections.name: Women's Collection
keyCollections.description: Contemporary women's timepieces with distinctive colour palettes and refined proportions, designed to stand apart in India's growing independent watch landscape.

timeline.event: Rajeev Asrani and Deepak Choudhury launch Horpa, drawing on nearly two decades of experience in the global luxury watch industry.
Establishes its design identity around bold colour experimentation and Indian-designed aesthetics, gaining a following among India's watch enthusiast community.
Continues to expand its collections, positioning itself as one of India's credible independent watch voices with a focus on design excellence over volume.

faqItems.question: What does Horpa stand for?
faqItems.answer: HORPA stands for Horology and Passion — reflecting the founders' deep love for watchmaking and their mission to build a world-class Indian watch brand.

faqItems.question: Where are Horpa watches designed?
faqItems.answer: Horpa watches are designed and constructed in India, with the brand's philosophy centred on 'Construction of Design Excellence' using Japanese quartz movements.

name: Beijing Watch Factory
description: Beijing Watch Factory is one of China's original state-owned watchmakers, renowned for its mastery of the tourbillon complication and traditional Chinese decorative arts applied to haute horlogerie. The manufacture has produced some of the most complex mechanical movements ever built in China, including minute repeaters and enamel-dialed tourbillons that have earned international collector recognition.

keyCollections.name: Tourbillon
keyCollections.description: The flagship complication line featuring in-house tourbillon movements with hand-engraved bridges, enamel dials, and traditional Chinese motifs — representing the pinnacle of Chinese mechanical watchmaking.

keyCollections.name: North
keyCollections.description: Heritage-inspired dress watches powered by refined in-house movements, offering classical Chinese design language at accessible price points.

keyCollections.name: Classic
keyCollections.description: Everyday mechanical watches drawing from decades of manufacture tradition, featuring reliable automatic movements with clean, understated aesthetics.

timeline.event: Beijing Watch Factory is established as one of China's original state watchmaking enterprises, initially focused on producing basic mechanical movements.
Develops China's first self-made tourbillon movement, marking a milestone in the country's pursuit of haute horlogerie complications.
Produces the Double-Axis Tourbillon, demonstrating the factory's capacity for complex multi-axis complications.
Receives growing international recognition, with collectors and enthusiasts acknowledging Beijing's tourbillons as serious horological achievements.

faqItems.question: What makes Beijing Watch Factory significant?
faqItems.answer: Beijing Watch Factory produced China's first domestically made tourbillon in 2004 and has since built double-axis tourbillons and minute repeaters — proving that Chinese manufacture can achieve genuine haute horlogerie complexity.

faqItems.question: How do Beijing Watch Factory prices compare to Swiss equivalents?
faqItems.answer: Beijing's tourbillons typically cost a fraction of comparable Swiss complications, offering in-house tourbillon movements from around $2,000 to $20,000 — a fraction of what similar Swiss pieces command.

name: Shanghai Watch
description: Shanghai Watch holds the distinction of producing China's first domestically manufactured wristwatch in 1955, a milestone that launched the nation's horological industry. The historic brand continues to produce mechanical watches that honour its heritage while remaining one of the most culturally significant names in Chinese watchmaking.

keyCollections.name: 1955 Reissue
keyCollections.description: A faithful re-edition of the first Chinese-made wristwatch, celebrating the model that launched an entire national industry and carrying deep cultural significance.

keyCollections.name: Skeleton
keyCollections.description: Open-worked timepieces showcasing Shanghai's in-house movements through intricate skeletonisation, blending mechanical transparency with art-deco-inspired design.

keyCollections.name: Complication
keyCollections.description: Higher-end pieces featuring moon phases, retrograde displays, and tourbillons, demonstrating the manufacture's expanding mechanical ambitions.

timeline.event: Shanghai Watch Factory produces China's first domestically manufactured wristwatch — the A581 — marking the birth of the Chinese watchmaking industry.
Formally established as the Shanghai Watch Factory, becoming one of China's primary horological manufactures alongside Tianjin and Beijing.
Restructures amid market reforms, transitioning from pure state enterprise to a brand seeking relevance in the modern mechanical watch market.
Launches heritage reissue collections celebrating its founding role in Chinese watchmaking, gaining renewed attention from domestic collectors.

faqItems.question: Why is Shanghai Watch historically important?
faqItems.answer: Shanghai Watch produced China's first domestically made wristwatch in 1955, the A581. This single achievement launched the entire Chinese watchmaking industry and remains a point of national pride.

faqItems.question: Does Shanghai Watch still make watches?
faqItems.answer: Yes. While production volumes have declined from their mid-century peak, Shanghai Watch continues to produce mechanical watches — including heritage reissues and limited-edition complications — for the domestic and international collector market.

name: Fiyta
description: Fiyta is China's only publicly listed watchmaker and the official timekeeper of the Chinese space programme, having accompanied every crewed Shenzhou mission since 2003. The Shenzhen-based brand bridges Chinese industrial capability with horological ambition, producing in-house movements and complications that have earned it a unique position in both national heritage and the global watch landscape.

keyCollections.name: Aerospace
keyCollections.description: The space programme collection — engineered for and worn by Chinese taikonauts on Shenzhou missions. Functional, tool-watch design with in-house movements rated for extreme conditions.

keyCollections.name: Solo
keyCollections.description: In-house automatic collection showcasing Fiyta's proprietary movements, demonstrating the brand's growing manufacture capability beyond its space heritage.

keyCollections.name: Classic
keyCollections.description: Refined dress watches featuring clean aesthetics and reliable automatic movements, representing accessible Chinese mechanical watchmaking at its best.

timeline.event: Fiyta is founded in Shenzhen as a state-owned watch enterprise, initially focused on assembling and distributing mechanical watches in China.
Becomes the official watch of China's crewed space programme when Yang Liwei wears a Fiyta Aerospace chronograph aboard Shenzhou 5 — China's first crewed spaceflight.
Develops its first in-house automatic movement, the YH7, signalling a shift from assembly to genuine manufacture.
Exhibits at Baselworld, marking China's growing presence on the international horological stage.
Supplies timepieces for China's space station programme, continuing a two-decade partnership with the national aerospace authority.

faqItems.question: Is Fiyta really used in space?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Fiyta has been the official timekeeper of every Chinese crewed space mission since Shenzhou 5 in 2003, making it one of only a handful of watch brands with genuine spaceflight heritage alongside Omega and Fortis.

faqItems.question: Does Fiyta make its own movements?
faqItems.answer: Fiyta produces several proprietary movements including the YH7 automatic calibre and has invested heavily in manufacture capability, though it also uses movements from Seagull and Swiss suppliers across its range.

name: Peacock
description: Peacock is the brand name of the Liaoning Watch Factory, one of China's original state watchmaking enterprises, celebrated for its mastery of enamel dial artistry and classical Chinese decorative techniques. The manufacture combines traditional cloisonne and painted enamel work with mechanical complications, producing timepieces that serve as wearable expressions of Chinese artistic heritage.

keyCollections.name: Enamel Art
keyCollections.description: Hand-painted and cloisonne enamel dial watches depicting traditional Chinese motifs — landscapes, birds, calligraphy — each dial requiring dozens of hours of artisan work and multiple kiln firings.

keyCollections.name: Tourbillon
keyCollections.description: Mechanical tourbillon watches paired with Peacock's signature enamel dials, combining horological complexity with decorative artistry at a fraction of Swiss prices.

timeline.event: The Liaoning Watch Factory is established in Dandong as one of China's earliest state watchmaking facilities.
Begins developing its signature enamel dial capabilities, investing in traditional Chinese decorative arts applied to watch dials.
Gains international collector attention for its cloisonne and painted enamel work, with quality rivalling significantly more expensive Swiss enamel houses.
Continues to produce limited-edition enamel and tourbillon pieces, serving as a custodian of traditional Chinese decorative arts in a horological context.

faqItems.question: What makes Peacock special?
faqItems.answer: Peacock is one of the very few watchmakers in the world — and the foremost in China — specialising in hand-painted and cloisonne enamel dials, a rare and time-intensive art form that few Swiss brands still practise.

faqItems.question: How does Peacock enamel compare to Swiss enamel?
faqItems.answer: Collectors widely regard Peacock's enamel work as comparable in quality to Swiss houses like Donze Cadrans, while costing a fraction of the price — making the brand a favourite among enamel enthusiasts.

name: Memorigin
description: Memorigin is a Hong Kong-based tourbillon specialist founded in 2011 by William Shum. The brand positions itself as a local Hong Kong tourbillon maker, combining Chinese and Western design cues with flying tourbillon movements, cultural themes, and limited collaborations across collections such as Stellar, Glorious, Art, and Lady Tourbillon.

hq.address: Unit 1603, 16/F, Tower 1, Millennium City 5, 418 Kwun Tong Road, Kwun Tong

keyCollections.name: Stellar Series
keyCollections.description: Astronomical and cultural tourbillon designs, including automatic flying-tourbillon variants with GMT and power-reserve displays.

keyCollections.name: Glorious Series
keyCollections.description: A modern Memorigin line tied to the brand’s Hong Kong identity and specialty-store milestone.

keyCollections.name: Art Series
keyCollections.description: Tourbillon watches using decorative dials and cultural design themes.

keyCollections.name: Lady Tourbillon
keyCollections.description: Women-focused tourbillon models that adapt the brand’s complication-first identity to smaller, jewelry-adjacent designs.

timeline.event: Memorigin is founded in Hong Kong by William Shum with the mission of making tourbillon watches accessible to a broader audience.
Gains international media attention through creative collaborations and artistic tourbillon designs, establishing Hong Kong as a source of accessible complications.
Expands its global distribution network and continues to refine its proprietary tourbillon offerings across multiple collections.
